title: The Top Signs That You're in Control of Your Life
paragraphs: What does it mean to have your life under control? According to a recent survey in the UK, the answer may have less to do with big life events than with small, everyday habits.

The survey, which was commissioned by the energy company British Gas, asked 2,000 adults in Britain about the signs that show a person has their life together. The results were published in August 2026.

The most popular answer was making regular payments into a savings account, which was chosen by 52% of respondents. However, emotional signs also ranked very highly, taking four of the top eight places. Around 43% of people said that being able to enjoy your own company was a sign of being in control, while 42% said the same about being able to admit when you are wrong. In addition, 37% mentioned being able to say no to things you do not want to do, and 33% pointed to having a strong and healthy group of friends.

Other answers were related to money and the home. For example, 36% said that not paying for subscriptions you do not use was a sign of being in control, and 35% said the same about knowing which day the garbage is collected. Around 30% mentioned putting clothes away instead of leaving them on a chair, while 28% said keeping kitchen cupboards in order was important.
Health habits also appeared on the list. About 28% of people chose drinking two liters of water a day, and 22% said booking a dentist appointment before you are in pain was a good sign.

Interestingly, the survey found that people feel most in control of their lives at the average age of 50. However, 30% said they were nowhere near having their life sorted, and 56% believed that nobody ever has their life completely under control.
